worked.problem: A box has 18 blue and 30 red counters. Write the blue:red ratio in simplest form.
actions: Identify the ordered ratio blue:red as 18:30.
The greatest common factor of 18 and 30 is 6.
Divide both parts by 6: 18÷6:30÷6 = 3:5.
Check: 3×6=18 and 5×6=30; the order remains blue:red.
wrong_methods: Reverses the stated order of the colours.
Leaves the ratio unreduced.
Uses a combined total instead of the blue part.
worked.check: Check: 3×6=18 and 5×6=30; the order remains blue:red.
